request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft strings, gentle pad, reverent and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Keep your life free from the love of money
Be content with what you have today
He has said I will never leave you
Nor forsake you in the long way

[Verse]
So we can say with confidence now
The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid
What can anyone do to me
He stands beside us in the shade

[Verse]
Remember your leaders who spoke the word
Consider how their lives turned out
Imitate their faith in the light
Stand firm when the shadows are out

[Chorus]
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday
And today and forever he remains
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday
And today and forever he holds us

[Verse]
Do not be carried away by strange teachings
It is good for the heart to be strong
Strengthened by grace and not by rules
Where the true and living grace is sung

[Verse]
We have an altar they cannot eat from
The high priest carries blood inside
But the bodies are burned outside the camp
In the place where the truth abides

[Chorus]
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday
And today and forever he remains
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday
And today and forever he holds us

[Outro]
He is the same yesterday
And today and forever
